name: Pancake

semantic.light.fg.muted.why: Pancake 1 decision: content.muted is neutral.700 (Pancake's mid greys are lighter than letbe's)

semantic.light.border.strong.why: Pancake 1 decision: border.control is neutral.600, the lightest grey that passes 3:1

notes: Source: Pancake DS 1 (expert-octo-pancake), tokens/tier-1-definitions/color.json, copied as brand-tokens.json.
Neutrals and the brand blue come straight from Pancake 1: #FAFAFA (neutral.50), #212121 (neutral.900), #0A5CFF (blue.600).
The accent (and the dormant accent-2 / accent-3 slots) moves from letbe's violet to Pancake's blue. blue.950 keeps the base value: Pancake 1's ramp stops at 900.
Status colours, type, radius and shadows keep letbe's values for now.
